arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Seth Waxman argued the complaint alleges a national bank charged excessive interest.
Mr. Roberts asserted the National Bank Act provides the exclusive cause of action.
Mr. Clark argued federal removal jurisdiction is limited by statute to federal cases.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case determines whether borrowers can sue national banks under state usury laws. It defines the scope of federal preemption in banking disputes. It affects the legal remedies available to consumers nationwide.
